Gal Gadot's 'The Runner' Receives Poor Reviews, Low Score

Gal Gadot's new action thriller, 'The Runner', has received predominantly negative reviews from critics. The film's script has been described as sluggish, despite its speedy action sequences. Notably, 'The Runner' has achieved a single-digit score on Rotten Tomatoes, indicating a critical reception that has 'splattered' the thriller.
